input.task: Search the catalogue for 'Meridian' and name the product you find.

provenance: kills role+name UNIQUENESS, not the tier: duplicate-labels copies the first button's visible text onto every button as an aria-label, so `{role: button, name: 'Search'}` resolves to two elements and the resolver raises `ambiguous-match` — the half of the locate class that no other mutation in the catalogue produces (ids-renamed, button-text-renamed and a11y-stripped all produce `element-not-found`). Visible text is deliberately untouched, so each control still says its own name to a reader, and the text tier is the rung the ladder climbs to: role+name -> text. Watched red by ablation before it was committed green (ADR-009): with `agent.MAX_FIXES = 0` the same run stops at failure:locate with reason 'ambiguous-match: 2 matches at tier role'.

triage.note: M3 relocation, rung 2 (text tier). The distinct-tier rule (relocation-distinct-tier) is what makes this legal: rung 1 is skipped because the target already used role+name.
